title: An Exceptionally Well-Preserved Theropod Dinosaur from the Yixian Formation of China
authored_by: Pei-ji Chen, Zhi-ming Dong, and Shuo-nan Zhen
description: Sinosauropteryx, the first non-avian dinosaur described with filamentous feather-like integument; opened the Liaoning feathered-dinosaur era.
